snippet.title: Factoriant / Teaser Trailer / Steam
snippet.description:
Teaser trailer for our new factory builder game "Factoriant" !

Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332860/Factoriant/
Official Web：https://marudice.com/en
X（Twitter）：@dice_maru_en

Factoriant is a factory builder where you construct an underground ant factory.
As a queen ant, dig tunnels, carry food, and hatch worker ants to automate your production.
Defend your nest from threats like birds and humans, and build a subterranean ant colony.
